reason: The Ask quota undercharge behavior existed in the pre-remediation implementation, but the current route passes req.signal to the provider and settles the full reservation on request abort, SSE enqueue failure, and provider exceptions. The current estimator uses UTF-8 byte length and the database expiry sweep charges uncompleted reservations conservatively. It is therefore a remediated historical candidate, not a current exploitable finding. Real provider billing and PostgreSQL integration could not be run on this host.

Remote feed links and images are parsed through safeHttpUrl, browser consumers validate them again, and Feed/OPML serializers use safeShareableHttpUrl with an internal-reader fallback. Crafted javascript:, data:, credential-bearing, and private URL values do not reach a browser sink in the current code path.
